label: sec:archimedean-hartree-crystal-mass-tower-deeper-preamble
html: The analytic coherence of the Bloch–Wigner dilogarithm D(z) and the Clausen function \mathrm{Cl}_2(\theta) rests on the five-term pentagon relation in the Bloch group B(\mathbb{C}) = \ker(\nu)/\text{5-term}. This section constructs the Bloch-group quotient, establishes the \mathrm{Cl}_2 pentagon and partial Faddeev dilogarithm identities, and summarises the upstream real-analytic lemmas connecting polylogarithmic periods to the mass tower.
